title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation in Checkout Service
symptoms: Spike in HTTP 500 errors during peak checkout flow, database connection timeout exceptions, active connections reached maximum pool limit of 100
root_cause: Unreleased database connections due to missing context manager in payment transaction handler causing connection pool starvation
log_patterns: OperationalError: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 100 overflow 20 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00
FATAL: too many connections for role 'checkout_app'

title: Slow Third-Party Payment Gateway Inducing Upstream Request Backlog
symptoms: Upstream checkout API response times degraded to >5000ms, worker threads blocked waiting for payment provider HTTP response, high thread pool queue depth
root_cause: External payment processor webhook experiencing 15s latency without local socket read timeout configured, monopolizing worker threads
log_patterns: requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='pay-partner.internal', port=443): Read timed out
Thread starvation warning: thread pool queue size exceeded 500 tasks
Gateway timeout 504 received from payment upstream

title: Redis Cache Invalidation Storm Causing Database Overload
symptoms: Cache hit ratio dropped from 94% to 12%, instant 8x query throughput increase on catalog database replica, database CPU pegged at 98%
root_cause: Bulk product inventory cache key expiration synchronized at midnight with zero TTL jitter, triggering stampede on PostgreSQL primary
log_patterns: RedisCacheMiss: key prefix 'product_cat_' expired simultaneously
Postgres CPU alert: CPU utilization > 95% for 3 consecutive intervals
SlowQueryLog: SELECT * FROM product_variants took 4210ms

title: Uncaught Null Reference Exception in Inventory Stock Sync
symptoms: HTTP 500 error spike reaching 52% on /api/v1/inventory/reserve, stack trace reported in application logs, orders failing verification
root_cause: Supplier inventory feed sent null warehouse_id payload after upstream schema update, leading to unhandled AttributeError in inventory reservation service
log_patterns: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'warehouse_id'
Unhandled exception during order item reservation
HTTP 500 Internal Server Error returned to client

title: Circuit Breaker Tripped in Recommendation Engine Due to Downstream Hang
symptoms: Front page fallback widgets triggered, recommendation endpoint returning HTTP 503 Circuit Breaker Open state, zero traffic reaching recommendation model
root_cause: Vector search similarity cluster degraded due to out-of-memory node crash, causing consecutive call timeouts exceeding circuit breaker error threshold of 50%
log_patterns: CircuitBreakerOpenException: failure rate 68% exceeded threshold 50%
Short-circuiting request to vector-index cluster
Serving fallback static recommendations

title: High Traffic Burst Exceeding Worker Capacity in Order Ingestion
symptoms: Sudden 4x incoming request rate spike, worker thread pool 100% busy, HTTP 429 and 503 responses returned, elevated request queue latency
root_cause: Flash marketing campaign launched without auto-scaler threshold pre-warming, exhausting existing 4 worker container capacity
log_patterns: Gunicorn worker timeout, worker pid 1828 killed
CapacityAlert: worker saturation 100% across all available replicas
Backpressure queue full, rejecting incoming requests

title: Database Deadlock During Concurrent Basket Checkout Mutations
symptoms: Sporadic transaction rollbacks with HTTP 500, deadlock detection logs from PostgreSQL, latency jitter on /checkout/commit
root_cause: Inventory lock and basket lock acquired in reverse order in two concurrent API endpoints, creating cyclic transaction dependency deadlock
log_patterns: ERROR: deadlock detected - Process 4812 waits for ExclusiveLock on tuple
TransactionRollbackError: serialization failure due to concurrent lock conflict
Rollback executed for transaction tx_98124

title: DNS Resolver Timeout Cascading to Internal Auth Validation
symptoms: Token verification taking 5000ms instead of 5ms, auth service failing token exchanges, intermittent 502 Bad Gateway responses
root_cause: CoreDNS pod restart during node upgrade causing local resolver cache misses and fallback to slow external root servers
log_patterns: socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution
DNS resolution timed out after 5000ms for auth.internal.mesh
Failed to verify JWT signature: public key JWKS fetch failed

title: Memory Leak in Product Search Image Resizer Worker
symptoms: Worker RSS memory steadily climbing until OOMKilled by Linux kernel, search queries intermittently dropping with 502
root_cause: PIL Image object buffer not closed after thumbnail rendering in background search indexer, leaking unmanaged C memory buffers
log_patterns: Process killed by OOM killer: search_worker pid 9123
Memory leak warning: container memory usage exceeded 95% threshold
Worker exited prematurely with exit status 137

title: Misconfigured Rate Limiting Filter Blocking Legitimate Mobile App Clients
symptoms: Spike in HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on all mobile endpoints, user complaints of inability to login or browse, zero backend service degradation
root_cause: Rate limit threshold mistakenly configured per-NAT-gateway IP instead of per-client-session ID in latest gateway route definition deployment
log_patterns: RateLimiter: IP 192.168.1.50 exceeded limit 100 req/min (actual: 4500 req/min)
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests response dispatched to user-agent 'ShopApp/3.2'
Token bucket depleted for client route /api/mobile/*

title: High Disk I/O Wait Stalling Application Write Operations
symptoms: Database commit latency increased from 4ms to 3500ms, write queries queueing, iowait metric on storage volume at 89%
root_cause: Automated snapshot backup process running concurrently with unindexed table vacuum during high business transaction volume
log_patterns: Storage I/O latency alert: disk await time > 80ms
PostgreSQL checkpoint warning: checkpoints occurring too frequently (9 seconds apart)
Write operation wait time exceeded warning limit

title: Stale Cache Rendering Incorrect Pricing Information
symptoms: Users seeing mismatched checkout prices vs product page prices, customer support escalation, stale response headers
root_cause: Redis pub/sub cache purge broadcast dropped due to network buffer overflow, leaving stale discount price cache entries active on secondary nodes
log_patterns: CacheConsistencyError: price discrepancy between redis cache and sql pricing table
PubSub message delivery dropped due to subscriber buffer overflow
Stale price tag detected on SKU 98214
